nodes.question: How were traditional fossil-fuel vehicles taxed differently after 2010 in the Netherlands?
nodes.answer: After 2,010 a 'fee bate' system was implemented where low-emission vehicles received a tax discount or exemption, while high-emission vehicles were taxed extra based on their CO2 emissions.
